name: Tübingen School

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Platonic-Aristotelian corpus and the oral tradition of the Academy

VINIT.justification: The absolute principle prior to all multiplicity and determination.

TANCH.justification: The final structural containment of all reality within the One and the Indefinite Dyad.

AFWD.justification: The outward movement from the One toward the generation of Forms and numbers.

AREV.justification: The analytical return from multiplicity to the underlying first principles.

CLINK.justification: The chaining of logical steps to link lower particulars to higher universals.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-thinking thought that recognizes its own identity with the Forms.

FSPLIT.justification: The principle of Great and Small that splits unity into plurality and magnitude.

FFUSE.justification: The imposition of the One upon the Dyad to reconstitute stable, unified Forms.

EVALT.justification: The successful realization of proportion and limit in a being.

EVALF.justification: The failure to achieve limit, resulting in chaotic indeterminacy.

ENGAGR.justification: The unwritten doctrines held in tension between the written text and oral transmission.

IFIX.justification: The permanent, fixed textual record that serves as a pedagogical entry point.

phase_3.void_description: The pre-ontological state before the interaction of the One and the Dyad.
phase_3.true_description: The state of Being characterized by Limit and Form.
phase_3.false_description: The state of Non-being or pure indeterminacy lacking Form.
phase_3.both_description: The Agrapha Dogmata where the esoteric and exoteric coexist in the teacher's mind.

steps.domain_action: The One exists as the absolute, undifferentiated source.
The One recognizes its own self-sufficiency as the first principle.
The Indefinite Dyad introduces the potential for multiplicity through the Great and Small.
The movement toward plurality begins as the One interacts with the Dyad.
The T-branch pursues the generation of Ideal Numbers and Forms.
Forms are linked sequentially to build the hierarchy of Being.
The F-branch descends into the material world of flux and shadow.
The material world fails to maintain the perfect unity of the One.
The principle of Limit reunites the Great and Small into a unified Form.
The unwritten doctrine holds the tension between the One and the Many without collapsing either.
The philosophical insight is recorded in the dialogues as a permanent pedagogical marker.
The entire ontological structure is anchored within the finality of the Henological system.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The dialectical method of the Academy
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The pedagogical progression from mathematics to dialectics
phase_5.alfs_store: The First Principles (The One and the Indefinite Dyad)

phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The system recovers the initial unity of the One through the synthesis of the Dyad.
